messages:
emma-ux: Quick standup thread for the permissions search + audit shortcuts comp. Two main asks: make it obvious which users are affected by role changes, and add one-click audit deep-links from search results.

paul-eng: Backend note: we can expose a compact /search/permissions endpoint returning affected_count and an audit_deeplink token. Keep payload tiny for instant results.

emma-ux: UI idea: inline "Affected: 8 users" chip next to each permission result; click expands quick panel with examples and a "View audit" link that pre-fills role_id + event types. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC/perm-search-v2 (page: quick-panel).

olivia-security: Love the audit link. Requirements: deep-link must include actor_id when generated from a modal, and the audit event types should be sso_change, permission_change, role_assignment. Also pre-fill last_30_days by default.

hannah-pm: Product ask: copy for the chip should be "Affected: 8 users" not "Users affected" to match action-first copy. Also for zero results show "No users will be affected" with a tooltip explaining why.

emma-ux: Accessibility: chip needs aria-label like "8 users affected by changes to Permission X" and the quick panel should be keyboard-trap friendly. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand animation.

a11y-bot: Checklist: [x] aria-label recommended, [ ] focus order for quick panel to be validated, [x] reduced-motion support noted. Recommend using aria-live polite when affected_count updates after search filters change.

paul-eng: Implementation detail: audit_deeplink will be a short token to avoid leaking IDs, e.g., /audit?token=txZ. Server will resolve token -> params and enforce rate-limits.

olivia-security: Token is fine. Also require that any change flow that starts from the quick panel emits an audit context payload: {actor, prior_value, new_value, reason}. If user toggles SSO from here we must show a confirmation modal for admin-level effects.

emma-ux: Confirmation microcopy: "This change will affect X users and may change sign-in behavior. Confirm to proceed." For admin perms require an extra checkbox: "I understand this will grant admin access."

hannah-pm: Rollout suggestion: gate quick-panel by feature flag and collect telemetry: perm_search_opened, affected_chip_click, audit_deeplink_click. Use rollout to 10% first.

a11y-bot: Micro-nit: ensure the confirmation checkbox is programmatically required (aria-required) and focus lands on it when modal opens.

paul-eng: One more: for large orgs, computing affected_count could be expensive. We'll return an estimate first with an info icon and fetch exact count in background. UI should show an asterisk with tooltip "estimate" until exact returns.

emma-ux: Good call. I'll mock the asterisk and tooltip in the comp. Also adding a small hint: "Estimates are updated live; click to refresh."

olivia-security: Make sure estimates don't leak membership PII. For public/shared links redact exact counts if the user lacks permission; show "—" instead.

hannah-pm: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) affected chip + quick panel implemented, 2) audit deep-links from results work with token and prefilled filters, 3) confirmation flows for admin-level changes, 4) accessibility checklist completed, 5) rollout behind feature flag with telemetry.

emma-ux: I'll update Figma and add the a11y appendix and copy changes. Will post final frames for review. Thanks! :sparkles:
